stage1.impression: A strong, moody idea: a dark speaker against a glowing wall of smoke, cut into shafts by trunks, with light pooling on the forest floor. The atmosphere and the ground read close to photographic. But the trunks are smooth brown cylinders with no bark, the whole frame is one orange-sepia tone, and the speaker's body is a nearly flat dark mass whose tinted acrylic barely glows. It reads as a very good render, not yet a photograph.

blocking_9: Tree trunks show real pine bark (plates, fissures, lichen) at the frame's resolution; today they are smooth gradients (trunk 1280-1420 x 300-900 lum_range 16.9)
The speaker's front face separates into tinted acrylic, woofer and lining; today body lum_median 24.8, p95 46, so the woofer barely reads
Colour is not a single orange cast: shadows and smoke carry some neutral/cool separation (smoke b_median 70 against r 156)
The rim reads on both sides of the silhouette, not only the right (left-edge step -32 vs right -173)
No floating or detached twigs/branch stubs in the sky area

defects.what: Mid trunk is a smooth, untextured brown gradient (lum_range 16.9); bark bump does not read; looks like CG cylinder
Near left trunk equally smooth and featureless at close range
Large right trunk smooth, no bark detail, root flare looks like a modelled cone
Speaker body crushed to a flat dark mass (median 24.8, p95 46.1); woofer and lining barely legible, tint does not glow
Left edge of speaker has almost no rim light (step -31.9) while the right has a strong one (-172.7); silhouette uneven
Amplifier/port box inside the base reads as grey-white plastic through the tint, the brightest thing in the lower body, distracting
Lone straight branch stub floats against the smoke at top centre, reads as a detached stick
Backplate leaf silhouettes through the smoke look like a soft, low-detail photo layer; slight seam with modelled trunks
Whole frame one monochrome orange-sepia tone; no colour separation between smoke, ground and product
Contact shadow weak; ground under the base hardly darker than the surrounding shaded ground (median 23.8 vs foreground 31.7)

changes.problem: The pine trunks read as smooth CG cylinders, the single biggest 'render' tell.

evidence.measured: lum_range 16.9, lum_p5 56.5 / p95 73.4: no bark micro-contrast at all; crop shows a plain gradient

change.to: true displacement 0.025 m on the bark height map, bump 8, tint 10 %, add a 15 % lichen/moss mask on the shaded side, bark texture scale so plates are 6-12 cm

changes.expected: Bark plates and fissures visible on the mid and near trunks, even through the smoke; trunk lum_range above 40.

changes.problem: The speaker's body is crushed; the smoked acrylic, woofer and lining do not read, so the $20k product is just a dark box.
changes.expected: Front face lifts by about a stop in the mids; woofer cone and surround separate from the baffle while the speaker still reads darker than the smoke.

changes.problem: The rim light is one-sided: the left edge of the silhouette barely separates.

evidence.measured: edge step -31.9 on the left vs -172.7 on the right (1040-1110)

change.to: irradiance 60, elevation 16°, move azimuth to -160° so it grazes the left vertical edge

changes.expected: A thin warm line along the left edge of the cabinet, matching the right.

changes.problem: The frame is a single orange-sepia cast; no separation between the cream smoke, the umber ground and the black product.

evidence.measured: smoke r/g/b median 156/110/70; ground fg 47/29/15; everything sits on one hue

change.setting: Render white balance / Sun lamp colour
change.to: white balance cooled by about 500 K; sun #FFC690; sky fill raised to irradiance 3.5 so the speaker's shadow side carries a faint cool note

changes.expected: Smoke reads cream-gold rather than orange; shadows on the ground and speaker are neutral-cool against the warm shafts.

changes.problem: The speaker does not sit firmly on the ground; the contact shadow is weak.

evidence.measured: lum_median 23.8 under the base vs 31.7 in the shaded foreground; contact crop shows little occlusion

change.to: feet sunk 30 mm, scatter a few leaves and needles against the base on its shaded side; reduce ground-hugging smoke layer within 0.5 m of the speaker so the occlusion is not washed out

changes.expected: A clear dark contact line along the base and litter touching the plinth.

changes.problem: The photographed backplate shows through the smoke as a soft, low-detail layer with leaf blotches that do not match the modelled trunks.

evidence.measured: lum_range 68.5 with blotchy leaf silhouettes, more contrast than the smoke around modelled trunks (bg_above_horn range 39.7)

change.to: density 0.19 beyond 9 m (keep 0.15 nearer), sky strength 0.10

changes.expected: The plate dissolves into the smoke wall; only modelled trunks carry silhouette.

changes.problem: A lone straight branch stub floats against the smoke at the top centre.

evidence.measured: seen in crop: a thin dark straight stick detached from any visible trunk

change.from: stub on the trunk at about x 920 in frame, top
change.to: remove that stub or shorten it under 0.3 m and bend it

changes.expected: No isolated sticks against the bright smoke at the top.

changes.problem: The finish is too clean for a photograph; no grain, and micro-contrast is low.

evidence.measured: foreground lum_range 40.9; overall image without grain

change.to: contrast 0.06, clarity 0.06, film grain 0.015 at 1.2 px

changes.expected: Slightly crisper litter and trunk detail with a photographic grain texture.

out_of_scope.request: The amplifier/port box inside the base reads as grey-white plastic through the tint; a darker finish on it would help.
out_of_scope.why: It is a part of the speaker; changing its colour or material is a product change. Lighting changes (c2) should be checked not to make it brighter.
